moods.calm: Peaceful, reflective, reassuring -- suited to quiet or contemplative moments.
moods.joy: Upbeat, celebratory, warm -- suited to positive, uplifting moments.
moods.adventurous: Energetic, driven, triumphant -- suited to moments of action or overcoming odds.
moods.dark: Somber, tense, subdued -- suited to serious or sorrowful moments.
